card.name: Neurologic and cerebrovascular wording points
card.fires_on: Mainly the 'bro' in 'Cerebrovascular' in the heading 'Cerebrovascular Adverse Reactions, Including Stroke'. It also fires on a few linking words in neurologic or anticholinergic risk statements, such as 'increase' after 'may'.

modes.label: Cerebrovascular heading
modes.description: The middle of the word Cerebrovascular in section 5.2 headings of antipsychotic labels.

modes.label: Linking words in risk statements
modes.description: Short words such as 'increase', 'in' or 'and/or' just before neurologic or urinary side-effect terms.
modes.example: The concomitant use of anticholinergic drugs may<< increase>> risk of urinary retention and/or severe const

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: The middle of a personal name in a news article.
modes.example: led by Rud<<iger>> Rupp said their technology overcomes disadvantages
